// RED fixture for `no-cross-sync-cycle` — the lint MUST reject this.
// @identity-sink
// Identity originates a SYNCHRONOUS outbound cross-service call — but Identity is the SINK of the
// sync call graph (everyone may call it synchronously; it calls no one synchronously). A sync
// call out of Identity makes a cycle possible (EI-02 §3).
pub async fn notify_other_service(client: &SyncServiceClient) {
    let _ = client.call_sync(build_request());
}
